title: ajuga glabrescens
intro: Ajuga glabrescens, commonly known as Bugleweed or Dragon's Mouth, is a perennial plant species in the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its adaptogenic and sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of Ajuga glabrescens include its ability to lower blood pressure and exhibit antispasmodic properties, making it useful for treating cardiovascular issues and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
